Name: AC Dig Spot and More
Author: Cidrei
Description:
Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18]original Animal Crossing dig spot mod[/url], here is yet another artifact dig spot texture replacement mod.

In addition to the Animal Crossing dig spot, you can also choose between much brighter colored worms and twigs, worms and twigs in the AC spot, and even the original worms and twigs if you wanted one look for both spots.

The dig spot options can be configured, as well as enabled or disabled, via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].
